title: Cold War alliances, economic blocs and political organisations
coverage: 1945-1993 core Cold War period; selected treaty relationships continuing beyond 1993 are retained with explicit end-date semantics.
datePolicy: Use treaty signature, entry-into-force, accession, withdrawal or dissolution dates according to the event described. Never infer a member withdrawal from a command-structure suspension. Where only year/month is verified, preserve partial precision in the report and do not fabricate a day.
capitalPolicy: capitalHistorical is the capital used by the state at the membership start date; disputed, de facto or government-in-exile seats are annotated. It is a descriptive city string, not a region ID.
membershipPolicy: Member rows represent treaty parties or formal organization members, not protected territories, observers, associate members or states covered by a treaty protocol. Those categories are separately labelled.

organizations.name_vi: Tổ chức Hiệp ước Bắc Đại Tây Dương
notes: The Federal Republic of Germany joined in 1955; German reunification on 3 October 1990 extended the Federal Republic's membership to the former GDR, not a separate GDR accession.
France remained a political member throughout; it withdrew from the integrated military command in 1966 and fully rejoined that structure in 2009.
Greece remained a political member while its forces withdrew from the integrated military structure in August 1974; reintegration approved 20 October 1980.

organizations.name_vi: Tổ chức Hiệp ước Trung tâm (Hiệp ước Baghdad)

validationNotes: This is a research package, not the engine's final diplomacy schema. Claude must map member state names and historical capitals to canonical entity IDs and map capital cities to region IDs.
Treaties with protected territories (SEATO protocol) must not be modelled as organization members.
A political organization, economic bloc, alliance, bilateral treaty and associate/observer relationship are different relationship classes.
Membership date must represent legal accession/effect, not necessarily treaty signature. Where not verified to a day, retain year/month precision and do not coerce to YYYY-MM-DD.

The Rio Treaty and OAS founding member rows use founding signatory/early-party cohorts; exact national ratification dates and later withdrawal/suspension histories require a dedicated member-by-member pass.
The OAU list is a selected Cold War accession roster; current AU members and post-1991 accessions are not silently back-projected.

Historical capitals are time-sensitive: Karachi (Pakistan), Rangoon (Burma), Leopoldville (Congo), Lagos (Nigeria), Dar es Salaam (Tanganyika), Zomba (Malawi), Salisbury (Zimbabwe), East Berlin (GDR), Bonn (FRG), and Taiz (Yemen) are retained where historically relevant.

CG-46b adds ISO alpha-3 identifiers and historical-capital point coordinates to all economic-bloc and political-organisation member rows only; military-alliance rows remain unchanged. Historical/legacy and geographic-anchor codes are annotated and are not canonical engine entity IDs.
capitalLat/capitalLon are approximate WGS84 city-point coordinates rounded to 0.01 degree for map placement; they are not region centroids or territorial ownership geometry.
EEC/EU customs union completed 1968-07-01; the six founding members entered on that date and later accessions entered on their EEC accession effective date.
